Meet your guide

Zohra
Shakti

I’m Zohra. I’m a spiritual coach, medium, and yogini. I work with various modalities: Tarot, Astrology, Numerology, Crystals Therapy, Reiki, Theta Healing. The best way to describe these sessions: Intuitive Guidance and Healing.

What can my sessions help you with? Everything! From getting clear on your life path and how to attract wealth to what makes you desirable and how you can find harmony in your relationships. The healing sessions can help address old wounds and deep-seated fears so we can rewrite the narrative. I offer both 1:1 coaching as well as group workshops and classes.

My yoga sessions are not just about perfecting the poses but about finding mind, body and soul alignment. They’re about working with the breath and regulating the nervous system so we may find ease as we move through the day.

I also specialise in Womb Healing sessions, helping women address issues related to their endocrine and reproductive system, from PCOS and PCOD to birthing and fertility issues. The intention: releasing past trauma so they can reclaim their sensuality, their creativity and their goddess-given power.

In addition, I’ve been writing horoscopes for various publications. I wrote daily horoscopes for Vogue India for 7 years before transitioning to Vogue Arabia, where I contribute a weekly column.
